what: tfpp-glm v1 as it ran on hardware on 2026-10-23, frozen before any v2 code (spec v2 section 1, 6)

post_v1.what: v1 files changed after the 2026-10-23 hardware runs, for documented defect fixes and publish hygiene (IMPLEMENTATION_NOTES.md, 'After the hardware runs'; CPU-tested, not yet re-run on hardware). The hardware hashes above stay as they were; each entry pins the file as it is now.

changes: Link.accept_linked: the listener stays open until a connection exchanges LINK; strays (probes, silent or non-LINK clients, a peer that closed after its LINK) are dropped, each connection has 5 s for its LINK; a LINK of another protocol version is a ProtocolError at once
recv(link_frame=True): a first-frame header over 64 KiB or with parts is a ProtocolError (not a tfpp-glm peer: connect_down refuses it instead of retrying until its deadline)
leader_listen / follower_connect use Link.accept_linked (a stray connection can no longer take the link)
forward_or_fail raises LinkError instead of sys.exit(75): follower.run returns 75 and serve's os._exit skips the interpreter teardown
connect_down's docstring names what is refused at once
check_chain also requires a KDA layer in every stage (one graph parity against two: BUILT would refuse it only after every weight is loaded)
the prefill seam's failure is fatal only with chunks in flight or a link error; an error after every chunk was read (first-token sampling, grammar) goes through _run's END abort
exit 1 when neither trace holds a request, and for a request both runs left without a done or fail record (INCOMPLETE)
mine(): an MLX checkpoint's embed_tokens.scales / .biases belong with embed_tokens.weight
agree(): a refused window names each stage's budget, its need at the requested window, the window it fits and the least one (fit_table)
comments only (no KEY=value changed): points to MIA's published scripts/config.sh; a warning that HTTP_HOST=0.0.0.0 serves the API unauthenticated on every interface
two --help strings reworded; no code change
the same non-v2 changes as the live start_stage.sh: the CUDA-12 extension probe tolerates a missing extensions folder (it ended the script silently under set -euo pipefail)
the pid file is trusted only while its pid runs tfpp.glm.serve --role ROLE (is_stage / stage_pid); a stale one is removed
the GPU-server port guard reads GPU_GUARD_PORTS from node.env (default none); messages and comments reworded
